messages:
emma: Quick callout on /v1/ingest API docs — two small but important mismatches causing integration failures: 1) curl examples include a charset on Content-Type (application/json; charset=utf-8) but the runtime rejects any charset and expects exactly application/json; 2) the error example still shows \"error_message\": \"...\" and a 400 status, while staging returns 422 and a nested error object (error.message, error.code). Also some examples still use the old param name `prefill`.
rajesh: Thanks — do you have the exact staging response?
emma: Yep, pasted from staging:
```http
HTTP/1.1 422 Unprocessable Entity
Content-Type: application/json

{"error":{"message":"invalid payload: missing 'source'","code":422}}
```
rajesh: Ugh. The charset thing will break some curl demos and the python requests examples. I'll open a docs PR to: - tighten Content-Type examples to `application/json` (no charset), - replace flat error example with the nested `error` object and 422 status, - update examples/snippets to use `prefetch` instead of `prefill`, - add a very short migration note under the reference.
emma: Please also add tiny snippet changes for Python/JS showing robust error access: Python `err = resp.get('error'); if err: raise RuntimeError(err['message'])`; JS `if (resp.error) console.error(resp.error.message)`.
docs-bot: PR created by rajesh: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5129 — updates examples, snippets, and adds migration note.
rajesh: I ran the docs linter locally and fixed a couple of stray examples in community quickstarts that still had the charset. CI queued.
docs-bot: CI: docs-linter passed for PR #5129  https://ci.redwood.ai/13625
sdk-release-bot: Reminder: regenerate SDK snippet bundle and tag docs release after merge.
emma: I'll take Python SDK regen and run the smoke tests on staging once this merges.
rajesh: Merged and preview deployed: https://deploy-preview.docs.redwood.ai/ingest — examples now show `Content-Type: application/json`, 422 + nested error, and `prefetch` in request samples.
emma: Ran Python regen and smoke: parsing and error handling work now. Pushed a patch release (0.8.3) for the client. Closing loop. :thumbsup:
